010a–010l: local suture–Dirac, Maxwell and ADM/Palatini transport identities.
010m–010n: finite nonlinear canonical and Fourier-field sources.
010o: six-bracket formal theorem conditional on SmoothCompletion.
010p: nonorthonormal pointwise gradient and metric-shift proof.
010q–010r: abstract non-entailment of a Yang–Mills spectral gap from the stated Gauss constraints.
010s: pointwise 010p / 010o source attachment.
010t: nonzero rational canonical pairing with prime-word order distinction.
010u: typed jurisdictional admission/reader/receipt theorem; finite Enough witness.

The full real/Fréchet SmoothCompletion formalization is not proved by the finite Lean source chain. The missing AxiomaticBuild.lean remains an external source-report boundary. Never present the co-compiled import graph as a single theorem deriving all of physics.

## Governing evidence rules

A result must carry:
1. Jurisdiction and original source authority.
2. Exact mathematical statement or model definition.
3. Conditions and actual dependencies.
4. Source file, verifier or proof and passing receipt.
5. Scope and a typed OPEN field when required.

The 010u result defines Admitted(J,x) using typed Gate, governing constraint, Survival and three zero residuals. Its mathematical conclusions are projections and comparisons of those declared premises. It does not compute a new universal physical state or an optimal stopping law.
